cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we discuss me moving out, check my train time. You remember our first trips? I had to make you read the small print.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six twelve. I've checked five times. Your ticket's in your hand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good checking. Now the barrier: does this work, or do I need the booking email? Don't assume the big print tells us everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll walk you through. Are you scared of leaving me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then check whether you need a ticket for the platform. You always forgot the part that applied to you. We should get that straight first.
